headline_outcome: Own a Warehouse for Rent Money
primary_text: "Rent is dead money. I could be paying off my own warehouse for the same monthly cost." You're right — and you probably have been for years. The average small business renting industrial space in Melbourne's west pays $3,000–$5,000 a month with nothing to show for it. What if that same money went toward owning a brand-new warehouse in Truganina? Off-the-plan pricing means your monthly repayments can match what you're already paying in rent. Except now, every payment builds equity in a real asset — your asset. Near Princes Freeway with West Gate Tunnel access. Stop funding your landlord's retirement.
description: Monthly repayments comparable to current industrial rents in the west
